UREJELEOMATINI KATIKA UWASILISHAJI WA MAUDHUI YA DHULUMA KATIKA RIWAYA YA
MSICHANA WA MBALAMWEZI (K.W.WAMITILA).
Waandishi wa riwaya ya Kiswahili ya kisasa wanawasilisha ujumbe kwa hadhira kwa kujikita katika mbinu za kiuandishi za kimajaribio.
Urejeleomatini ni mojawapo wa vipengele muhimu vya mbinu hizo za kimajaribio.
Riwaya zenyewe zimeitwa “riwaya za kimajaribio” au “riwaya za kisasa”.
Watalaamu wengine wamezibaini kama “riwaya za Karne ya Ishirini na Moja.
Mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila ni mmojawapo wa waandishi wa kisasa anayetumia mtindo huu mpya wa kiuandishi katika kuzungumzia maswala mbalimbali yanayoikumba jamii.
Nadharia ya usasaleo imeongoza utafiti huu katika uchanganuzi wa kipengele cha urejeleomatini.
Aina mbali mbali za matini zilizorejelewa katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma zilitambulishwa na kufafanuliwa.
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ilichaguliwa kimaksudi kwa kuwa inawasilishwa kwa simulizi nyingi fupi fupi zinazorejelea matini tofauti tofauti.
Mbinu ya uchanganuzi wa yaliyomo mkabala wa kimaelezo ilitumika kuchanganua deta iliyohusiana na swala zima la urejeleomatini.
Deta ilichanganuliwa kwa kuangazia maudhui, mandhari na mbinu za kiuandishi za kimajaribio.
Matokeo yaliwasilishwa kwa njia ya kimaelezo.
Ilibainika kuwa ukosefu wa utaratibu katika uendeshaji wa mambo ndiyo taswira kamili ya jamii ya sasa.
Matini zilizorejelewa zimeonyesha kuwa mwananchi amedhulumiwa na kupewa huduma duni na viongozi.
Makala hii imehakiki na kutathmini jinsi mwandishi anavyotumia mbinu ya urejeleomatini kama kunga ya uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.

…………………………………………………………………………………………………….... Introduction:- 1.1 Utangulizi Makala hii imeshughulikia swala la urejeleomatini kama nyenzo ya kuwasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi (2011) ya Kyallo Wadi Wamitila.
Lengo kuu ni kutambulisha aina mbalimbali za matini zilizorejelewa katika juhudi za kuwasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma.
Mintarafu ya haya, makala imeonyesha jinsi riwaya ya kisasa ya Kiswahili inavyoisawiri taswira kamili ya jamii ya kisasa.
Hali hii imejadiliwa katika misingi ya nadharia ya usasaleo.
Address:-Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton, Kenya.
1.2 Muhtasari wa Riwaya ya Msichana Wa Mbalamwezi Mhusika mkuu katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ni Yosi Kanga.
Amekuwa na kazi nzuri na maisha mazuri.
Siku moja hali ilimbadilikia punde tu aliposherehekea miaka thelathini na mitano tangu azaliwe.
Yosi Kanga alitoka ofisini saa saba kwa mapumziko ya mchana.
Alijilaza katika bustani kisha usingizi ukambeba.
Aliota ndoto akiwa hatarini.
Katika ndoto hiyo, banati fulani aliyemfahamu kama msichana wa mbalamwezi alimwokoa.
Alielekea kujipa chakula cha mchana katika hoteli moja iliyokuwa karibu na makao makuu ya shirika la reli, Kenya Railways.
Baada ya chamcha anaanguka ghafla na kuugua.
Alipelekwa katika City Breeze Hospital na kulazwa mle.
Daktari alisema kwamba Yosi Kanga alikuwa na uvimbe kichwani na kwa sababu hiyo alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi.
Huduma mle hospitalini hazikuwa nzuri.
Madaktari na baadhi ya wafanyikazi waliwadhulumu wagonjwa.
Wengi wa wagonjwa hao walifariki kwa njia ambazo hazikueleweka.
Baadaye daktari mwanamke alimtembelea.
Mara alipomwona, Yosi alipatwa na hisia fulani.
Alijaribu kukumbuka alikokuwa amemwona yule daktari.
Daktari alimjulia hali na baada ya mazungumzo mafupi aliamua kumpasulia mbarika.
Uchunguzi na “scan zote za ECG reports” zilionyesha kuwa Yosi alikuwa buheri wa afya.
Daktari alimwagiza ajitayarishe kuondoka mle hospitalini.
Yosi alifurahi sana kwa kuwa ile “hukumu ya kifo” aliyopewa mle hospitalini ilifutiliwa mbali.
Kumbe huyu ndiye aliyekuwa mwokozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.
1.3 Usasaleo Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa katika misingi ya usasaleo.
Elementi kuu ya usasaleo ni ukiukaji wa kaida za uandishi za kihalisia.
Badala ya kuzingatia mfumo wa uhalisia mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila kama mwandishi wa kisasa ameandika riwaya hii kwa kuegemea uhalisia-mpya.
Rettova (2016) amemtaja Wamitila kama mwandishi anayeegemea usasaleo kwa kuwa anaenzi matumizi ya mbinu za kimajaribio.
Urejeleomatini ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa uandishi wa kisasaleo.
Wataalamu wamebaini kuwa ni vigumu kuweka mipaka kati ya usasa na usasaleo.
Usasa ni kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambacho kilifungamana sana na mabadiliko katika sanaa hasa kati ya miaka ya 1880–1930 barani Uropa.
Wakati huo mwanadamu alidhihirisha uwezo na nguvu zake za kuumba, kuimarisha na kuunda mazingira yake kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, teknolojia na majaribio (Best et al, 2001).
Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba hapo awali fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa.
Mabadiliko ya kisanaa yalihusisha tanzu za fasihi kama vile ushairi, tamthilia, riwaya, densi na filamu.
Maudhui ya dhati, lugha ya dhati, uasilia, na utaratibu kabambe ndio mambo yaliyotiliwa maanani.
Miji ya Uropa iliyoshuhudia mabadiliko haya ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Rome, London na Moscow.
Mabadiliko haya yaliitwa Usasa na haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa kiini na msingi wa usasaleo.
Abrams (1993) anashikilia kuwa Usasa hutumiwa kuelezea na kutambulisha sifa mpya za dhamira, tanzu, dhana na mitindo ya kifasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya Karne ya Ishirini yaani baada ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Ulimwengu.
Abrams anaendelea kusisitiza kuwa sifa zinazorejelewa hutofautiana kutegemea wahakiki husika.
Wamitila (2007) anasema, “Licha ya tofauti hizo, wahakiki wengi wanakubaliana kuwa msingi wa sifa hizo ni kujitenga na misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Kimagharibi au ule uliokuwako”.
Kwa mujibu wa haya, ni bayana kwamba usasa ulijitenga kabisa na taratibu za utunzi zilizofuatwa kabla ya Karne ya Ishirini.
Hata ingawa suala la wakati wa kuzuka kwa usasa na usasaleo ni jambo la mjadala, ni wazi kwamba usasaleo uliibuka na kujengwa katika misingi ya usasa.
Usasaleo uliibuka na kuasisiwa katika Karne ya Ishirini.
Ulihusishwa na Nietzchsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard miongoni mwa wengine.
Wataalamu wengine waliotoa michango yao kwa nadharia ya usasaleo ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987) ambaye anasisitiza kwamba ulimwengu wa sasa unajiegemeza zaidi kwenye maswala ya usasaleo ambapo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na binadamu wa sasa zinamulikwa kwa njia ya simulizi nyingi.
Mfafanuzi wa hivi majuzi wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991).
Makala hii imejikita katika maoni mbalimbali ya nadharia usasaleo kama ilivyoasisiwa na Jean – Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991) na wengine.
Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia tete kwamba ufahamu wa wanajamii umebadilishwa pakubwa na mabadiliko ya kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda.
Hali hii imepelekea jamii kubadilisha tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kiusasaleo.
Kipindi cha usasaleo kilivuruga mipaka iliowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi.
Hali hii imejitokeza katika mambo mbalimbali yanayomilikiwa na jamii ikiwemo fasihi.
Maisha na watu si wataratibu na kwa hivyo kazi za fasihi hazifai kuwa na utaratibu wowote.
Usasaleo unafungamana sana na utamaduni pendwa ambapo watu hufanya
mambo namna wanavyotaka wenyewe bila kufuata kanuni za kijadi.
Mwandishi anajipa kibali cha kutumia kazi ya msanii mwengine kuundia kazi mpya.
Mintarafu ya haya, makala hii imetambulisha aina za matini zilizorejelewa na mwandishi K.W.Wamitila katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi kuwasilishia maudhui ya dhuluma.
Isitoshe, imechanganua jinsi matini hizo zilivyotumika katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma.
Utafiti huu ulijikita katika kipengele cha urejeleomatini.
Carter (2006) anafafanua kwamba usasaleo hukiuka kaida na kanuni zote za utunzi.
Kanuni anazorejelea Carter zaweza kuwa za kimuundo na za kilugha.
Hivi ni kusema kwamba pamoja na fasihi pendwa, usasaleo huambatana na uigizaji pendwa.
Sifa moja maarufu katika fasihi pendwa ni “mkondo wa ung’amuzi” ambao ni mbinu ya kisimulizi katika uandishi wa kinathari inayotumia maelezo marefu yanayoyamulika mawazo yanayompitikia mhusika akilini (Wamitila, 2006).
Uigizaji huu hufanyika popote na haufuati utaratibu wowote.
Aghalabu, lengo la mwandishi huwa ni kuburudisha jamii tu.
Uigizaji pendwa hutumia lugha pendwa.
Kwa kuwa lugha ni kifaa muhimu katika uandishi wa kazi za fasihi usasaleo unaangazia matumizi ya lugha kwa njia huru sana bila kuzingatia ufasaha na usanifu wake.
Pia huhusu kuchanganya lugha mbalimbali kwa mfano Kiingereza na Kiswahili au lugha za kwanza na Kiswahili.
Dhana hii iliuelekeza utafiti huu katika uchanganuzi wa maswala mahususi ya matumizi ya lugha pendwa hasa uchanganyaji na uhamishaji ndimi katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.
Lugha iliyotumika hurejelea matini mbalimbali ambazo zinawasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma katika jamii.
Msingi wa usasaleo ulitumika kuuongoza utafiti katika uchanganuzi wa urejeleomatini kama mojawapo wa kipengele muhimu cha riwaya za kimajaribio.
Mtafiti amebaini jinsi kipengele hiki kilivyokosesha utaratibu katika riwaya teule.
1.4 Urejeleomatini Urejeleomatini ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza “intertexuality” lililotumika kwa mara ya kwanza na mwanafalsafa mfaransa, Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake cha ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966).
Kwa mujibu wa Kristeva, kila neno ni urejeleo wa maneno mengine.
Hivyo, kuna msisitizo kwamba matini huhusiana na kutegemeana ili kuleta maana.
Stam (2000) katika Anderson (2004:1) ananukuliwa, “Matini yoyote ile iibukayo lazima iwe imelala pamoja na nyingine au na matini nyingine ambayo ile ya awali imelala nayo”.
Usemi huu unadhihirisha kuwa kazi ya fasihi haitoki kwenye akili ya mtunzi pekee au katika ombwe tupu bali huwa ni mkusanyiko wa matini nyingine tofauti tofauti.
(Anderson, 2004) anadai kuwa urejeleomatini huhusisha “yaliyosemwa tayari”.
Urejeleomatini ni kipengele muhimu cha usasaleo ambamo Wamitila anaandikia.
Aidha, urejeleomatini ni mojawapo wa elementi kuu za uandishi wa kimajaribio.
Urejeleomatini unaojitokeza aghalabu katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi umeshamiri matumizi ya vihadithi vidogo vidogo, tanzu za fasihi simulizi, maoni ya wanafalsafa, ushairi/nyimbo na uchanganyaji wa lugha.
Matini hizi zote zimetumika katika riwaya hii kuwasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii kama vile afya, elimu na mapenzi.
Hali hizi zote huingiliana na kutegemeana katika ukuzaji wa ubunifu wa mwandishi.
Kwa mujibu wa Julia Kristeva (1980) matini huwa na uhusiano na matini nyingine.
Makala hii imebaini kwamba katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi matini mbalimbali zinahusiana, kutangamana na kutegemeana.
Jilala (2016) anaeleza kuwa maana ya matini moja hutokana na matini nyingine.
Katika fasihi maana imewakilishwa na maudhui (Mohammed, 1995).
Urejeleomatini katika riwaya teule umejitokeza kiviwango kama vile fani, uhusika, dhamira na maudhui.
Makala hii imetambulisha aina za matini zilizorejelewa katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma.
Enani (2005) anadai kwamba urejeleomatini huathiri namna ya usomaji wa matini mpya.
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imethibitisha kuwepo kwa mwingiliano wa kimtindo.
Vipande vingi vilivyorejelewa katika riwaya hii ni vya mitindo tofauti na vimeathiri msuko na ploti.
Hadhira inatiliwa huko na kutolewa kule.
Msomaji anasoma kipande cha hadithi na kabla ya kukikamilisha kingine kinaanzishwa.
Hali hii imepelekea kuleta uchangamano katika hadithi husika.
Wamitila (2010) anadai kuwa urejeleo wa aina hii waweza kuzua kuwepo kwa kazi hasi au chanya.
Bakhtin (1981:271) wanadai kuwa yanayosemwa huwa ni zaidi ya matamko yenyewe.
Miktadha mbalimbali huathiri kazi ya fasihi kwa njia tofauti.
Miktadha kama vile ya kiuchumi, kijamii au kisiasa huathiri mahusiano fulani katika kazi za fasihi (Wamitila, 2010).
Kwa mujibu wa haya, makala hii imechanganua na kuhakiki riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi na kutambulisha aina za miktadha mbalimbali inayorejelewa, mahusiano yake na jinsi mahusiano hayo yanavyochangia katika kuwasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma.
1.5 Matinirejelewa na Uwasilishaji wa Maudhui ya Dhuluma katika Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: Mtazamo wa usasaleo Nchi zinazoendelea huwadhulumu wananchi wake kwa njia tofauti tofauti.
Njia hizo hujitokeza zaidi katika jinsi huduma zinavyotolewa.
Kwa sababu mbali mbali ambazo wasanii huenda wakawa nazo, dhuluma hiyo huwasilishwa kibunifu kwa njia ya fasihi.
Ili kueleza hali hii kikamilifu, mbinu na nyenzo za uandishi hutumiwa kwa ustadi na ufundi.
Mwandishi K.W.
Wamitila ametumia kipengele cha urejeleomatini ili kueleza uozo na dhuluma iliyomo katika jamii yake.
Makala hii imeonyesha jinsi wananchi wa “kawaida” wanavyoteswa na maisha katika nchi yao kwa kukoseshwa huduma muhimu.
Sehemu hii imeeleza kwa kina aina za matini zilizorejelewa na mwandishi katika mawasiliano yake na jamii kuhusu dhuluma.
1.5.1 Matini za Kifalsafa Kulingana na Lyotard (1997), usasaleo unaegemea matumizi ya maoni ya kifalsafa katika utunzi.
Shinikizo na changamoto za ndani hueleweka vyema zikihusishwa na falsafa au usomi fulani.
Hata hivyo, matini za kifalsafa zinaweza kuwa changamano kwa wasomaji (Mwamzandi, 2013).
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imehodhi bunilizi ndogo ndogo zinazorejelea maoni ya wanafalsafa.
Falsafa ya utamaushi imempelekea mwandishi kukubali kuwa dhuluma anayopitia akiwa hospitalini ni hatua moja katika safari ya hatima yake ambayo ni kifo.
Mazingira ya hospitalini alipolazwa Yosi Kanga ambaye ndiye mhusika mkuu katika riwaya hii yalikuwa mabaya.
Mwandishi anasema kwamba vitanda vilikuwa vya zamani.
Anaeleza hali hiyo kwa kusema, “…vyuma vilivyolika na kuanza kuonyesha shumizi ya kutu hapa na pale, godoro dogo la usumba na kufunikwa shuka iliyochujuka rangi na kufanana na nguo iliyomwagiwa maji na kutoa mabakabaka”.
(MWM.
Uk.
25).
Mgonjwa anayerejelewa alikuwa ameshaambiwa na daktari kwamba alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi.
Kimsingi, hata mgonjwa akiwa katika hali mahututi anahitaji kupewa haki zake za kibinadamu.
Hali iliyopo hospitalini inamtamausha zaidi.
Hii ni kwa sababu inamdhulumu na kumnyima haki ya huduma bora hata ingawa alijua hatima yake ilikuwa kifo.
Zaidi anadhulumiwa katika hisia zake na hadi anaafikia kujiliwaza kwa mawazo ya kitamaushi; “…nitapumzika nitakapokuwa mfu baada ya siku chache na kama watu wetu wasemavyo siku zilizohesabiwa ni chache – huisha kwa kufumba na kufumbua”.
(MWM.
Uk.48).
Kwa mujibu wa Diegner (2005) falsafa ya kitamaushi inashikilia kuwa hatima ya binadamu ni kifo.
Haijalishi iwapo ana kazi nzuri au la.
Kando na kuwa na kazi nzuri iliyosimamia matibabu yake, suluhu ya pekee ya Yosi Kanga ilikuwa ni kifo.
1.5.2.
Matini za Kidini (Dini ya Kikristo, dini za kiasili) Yosi Kanga alikuwa na matatizo ya kiafya tangu jadi ambayo yalisababishwa na ajali za utotoni.
Kila alipopatwa na shida alipelekwa hospitalini kwa toroli lenye gurudumu lililopiga kelele nyingi.
Kila wakati watoto wa jirani waliposikia kelele ya gurudumu la toroli hiyo walijua Yosi anapelekwa hospitalini.
Watoto hao walisimama karibu na ua wa seng’enge wa shamba lao la matunda na kumfanyia ishara za vicheko na dharau.
Mwandishi anasema, “Nilitamani ningelikuwa na uwezo wa Daudi wa Biblia.
Niinuke kwenye ile toroli, nitafute tunguja mwitu au hata labda jiwe la tumbawe na kuwagotoa kwenye tosi za vichwa vyao na kuunyamazisha ugoliati wao” (MWM.
Uk.
21).
Yosi aliwaona watoto wa majiranize kama Goliati wa Biblia aliyewadhulumu na kuwakejeli wana wa Isiraeli.
Kwa mujibu wa dini ya Kikristo dhuluma ya Goliati kwa Waisraeli ilimalizwa na kijana mdogo, Daudi aliyelizungusha jiwe na kumwua.
Yosi alitamani kuwa iwapo angekuwa na uwezo kama wa Daudi angewanyamazisha wale watoto waliomcheka na kumdharau.
Aidha, vicheko vyao anavifananisha na Ugoliati.
Awali kidogo mhusika Konzi alimiliki hoteli moja ambamo alifanya kazi pamoja na mkewe.
Mwandishi anaeleza kuwa Konzi alizoea kuwadhulumu wanawake lakini ugonjwa huo ulipona alipooa.
Hata hivyo, aliendelea kumdhulumu mkewe kwa kuwatamani wanawake wengine waliokuja hotelini, machoni pa mkewe.
Mke wa Konzi aliyeitwa Tabitha anaiona hali hii kama kutomtii Muumba.
Anayerejelewa kama Muumba ni Mwenyezi Mungu.
Kwa Tabitha dhuluma kama hii ni tendo la kutotii mojawapo wa amri kumi za Mungu inayoonya dhidi ya uzinifu kama ilivyorekodiwa katika Biblia (Kutoka 20).
Tabitha alilipiza kisasi kwa mumewe kwa kumdhulumu zaidi.
Mwandishi anasema kwamba Tabitha alipasua kicheko kikubwa akigeuka huku na kule kama mtu aliyetaka kuuomba ushirika wa wenzake.
Mwishowe alimwuliza mumewe iwapo alimjua vizuri.
Tabitha aliishia kwa kusema, “Ikiwa wewe ni bafe, basi mimi ni bingwa wa kuitopoa sumu yake!” (MWM.
Uk.51).
Matini inazorejelewa katika simulizi hii ni ya kishirikina.
Mwandishi Wamitila anaeleza kuwa baada ya kioja hiki Bwana Konzi hakuweza kwenda haja kubwa wala kufanya haja ndogo.
Hakuweza kufika hotelini tena, “kuwaona hao wanawake wenye sura za nyanya wala kuwapakia siagi kwenye mikate yao” (MWM.
Uk.
51).
Ni dhahiri kuwa mkewe alitumia nguvu za kishirikina kumroga mumewe katika juhudi za kumdhibiti kutokana na “jicho la nje”.
Isitoshe, Konzi alipopelekwa katika hospitali kuu ya Machakos madaktari walishindwa kumsaidia.
Mwandishi anasema hata picha za uyoka (eksirei) hazikuonyesha tatizo lolote.
Tumbo lake liliposikizwa kwa stethoskopu kilichosikika ni sauti iliyofanana na kuwika kwa jogoo.
Alishauriwa na daktari kurudi nyumbani ambapo mkewe alicheka na kumzomea.
Baadaye alimpiga kofi dogo shavuni na tatizo la Konzi likaisha.
Imebainika kuwa Tabitha alitumia nguvu za kishirikina kumwadhibu yeyote aliyemvunjia heshima hasa mumwe Konzi.
Jamii ikikosa mbinu mwafaka za kuipa haki inajitafutia mbinu zake.
Katika muktadha huu, mbinu aliyotumia Tabitha inavunja utaratibu na maadili katika jamii.
Kwa kawaida mke humtunza na kumheshimu mumewe kwa vyovyote vile.
1.5.3 Matini za Kitaaluma Daktari alimwambia Mhusika Yosi Kanga kuwa tatizo la afya alilokuwa nalo lilikuwa la uvimbe uliokuwa kichwani.
Alizidi kutaja kwamba hakuwa na siku nyingi za kuishi.
Mwandishi ametumia maneno yafuatayo kueleza hali hii, “Inavyoelekea …mmm…ana tatizo la brain tumour…au hata intracranial hypertension…!
Ikiwa diagnosis yangu ni sawa kwa sababu sijawahi kukosea katika miaka yote hii niliyofanya kazi ya udaktari, ana siku kama ishirini na nane za kuishi…in fact it might even be less!” Matini za ujuzi wa kitaaluma zimetumiwa kumdhulumu Yosi kimawazo na kihisia.
Uchunguzi haukufanywa vizuri kwa sababu baadaye inabainika kuwa Yosi alikuwa buheri wa afya.
Daktari alijigamba kuwa msomi aliyesomea udaktari katika vyuo-tajika, “alumnus wa prestigious universities” (MWM.
Uk.
31).
Hivyo, alipozungumza kuhusu hali ya mgonjwa wake, Yosi alijua na kuamini ukweli kwamba siku zake duniani zilikuwa zimefikia ukingoni.
1.5.4 Matini za kisiasa Hali ya siasa mara nyingi huwadhulumu wanajamii.
Imebainika kuwa katika nchi nyingi zinazoendelea wanasiasa hutumia vijana kutekeleza matakwa yao.
Mwandishi wa riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi anasimulia kisa kinachowahusu wanajeshi.

INTERTEXTUALITY IN THE PRESENTATION OF THE THEME OF VIOLENCE IN THE NOVEL MSICHANA WA MBALAMWEZI BY K.W. WAMITILA. Authors of the modern Swahili novel convey messages to the audience by focusing on experimental literary techniques. Intertextuality is one of the key elements of those experimental techniques. The novels themselves have been called “experimental novels” or “modern novels.” Other experts have classified them as “Twenty-First Century novels.” The author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila is one of the modern writers who employs this new writing style to address various issues affecting society. The theory of postmodernism has guided this research in the analysis of the aspect of intertextuality. Various types of texts referenced in the presentation of the theme of violence were identified and explained. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi was deliberately selected because it is presented through numerous short narratives that reference different texts. The descriptive content analysis method was used to analyze the data related to the overall issue of intertextuality. The data was analyzed by focusing on themes, settings, and key elements of experimental writing techniques. The findings were presented descriptively. It was revealed that a lack of order in the conduct of affairs is the true reflection of today's society. The referenced texts have shown that the ordinary citizen has been oppressed and provided with poor services by the leaders. This article has examined and evaluated how the author uses the technique of intertextuality as a device for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Janice M. Introduction:- 1.1 Introduction This article addresses the issue of intertextuality as a tool for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi (2011) by Kyallo Wadi Wamitila. The main objective is to identify the various types of texts referenced in the effort to present the theme of oppression. Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory. Address:–Egerton University, Kenya. 1.2 Summary of the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi The main character in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is Yosi Kanga. He has had a good job and a good life. One day, things changed for her soon after she celebrated her thirty-fifth birthday. Yosi Kanga left the office at one o’clock for the afternoon break. She lay down in the garden, and soon sleep carried her away. He had a dream in which he was in danger. In that dream, a certain girl whom he knew as the msichana wa mbalamwezi saved him. He went to get lunch at a hotel near the headquarters of the Kenya Railways Corporation. After lunch, he suddenly collapses and falls ill. He was taken to City Breeze Hospital and admitted there. The doctor said that Yosi Kanga had a tumor in his head and, because of that, he had a short time to live. The services in the hospital were not good. The doctors and some of the staff mistreated the patients. Many of those patients died in ways that were not understood. Later, a female doctor visited her. The moment he saw her, Yosi was overcome by a certain feeling. He tried to remember where he had seen that doctor before. The doctor checked on his condition and after a brief conversation decided to break the news to him. Examinations and all ECG scan reports showed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor instructed him to prepare to leave the hospital. Yosi was very happy because the “death sentence” he had been given in the hospital was revoked. So this was his savior, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions. Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism. Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques. Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing. Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe. At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001). These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film. Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized. European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism. Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved. Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.” According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century. It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others. Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives. A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others. Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures. The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature. Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms. The writer gives himself permission to use another artist’s work to create a new one. With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Wamitila in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi to present the theme of oppression. Furthermore, it has analyzed how these texts were used in conveying the theme of oppression. This research focused on the aspect of intertextuality. Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic. This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance. One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006). This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society. Popular performance uses popular language. Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel. 1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning. Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.” This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts. (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes. In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing. All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author. According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts. This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other. Jilala (2016) explains that the meaning of one text is derived from other texts. In literature, meaning is represented by themes (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality in the selected novel has manifested at various levels such as form, characterization, motif, and themes. This article has identified the types of texts referenced in presenting the theme of oppression. Enani (2005) asserts that intertextuality influences the way a new text is read. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi has demonstrated the presence of stylistic intermingling. Many of the references in this novel are of different styles and have influenced the narrative structure and plot. The audience is taken here and there. The reader starts reading one segment of the story, and before finishing it, another begins. This phenomenon results in complexity within the story itself. Wamitila (2010) asserts that this type of reference can lead to either negative or positive outcomes. Bakhtin (1981:271) argues that what is said is more than just the utterances themselves. Different contexts affect literary works in various ways. Contexts such as economic, social, or political factors influence certain relationships within literary works (Wamitila, 2010). Accordingly, this article has analyzed and critiqued the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, identifying the different types of contexts referenced, their relationships, and how those relationships contribute to presenting the theme of oppression. 1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry. The author K.W. Wamitila has used the element of intertextuality to illustrate the decay and oppression present in his society. This article has demonstrated how "ordinary" citizens are tormented by life in their country due to being deprived of essential services. This section has thoroughly explained the types of texts referenced by the author in his communication with society concerning oppression. 1.5.1 Philosophical Texts According to Lyotard (1997), postmodernism is based on the application of philosophical ideas in composition. Internal pressures and challenges are best understood when related to a particular philosophy or body of scholarship. However, philosophical texts can be complex for readers (Mwamzandi, 2013). The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is dominated by short narratives that refer to the opinions of philosophers. The philosophy of existentialism has led the author to accept that the oppression he experiences in the hospital is just one step in the journey toward his ultimate fate, which is death. The environment of the hospital where Yosi Kanga, the main character in this novel, was admitted was deplorable. The author notes that the beds were old. He describes this situation by saying, “…the metal frames were worn and had started to show patches of rust here and there, the thin sisal mattress was covered with a sheet that had lost its color and resembled a garment soaked in water, leaving stains all over.” (MWM. Ok. 25). The patient referred to had already been told by the doctor that they had a short time to live. Basically, even a patient in a critical condition needs to be given their human rights. The situation in the hospital disheartens him even more. This is because it oppresses him and denies him the right to quality care, even though he knew his fate was death. Moreover, he is oppressed emotionally to the point where he consoles himself with existential thoughts: “…I will rest when I am dead after a few days, and as our people say, the numbered days are few—they pass in the blink of an eye.” (MWM. p.48). According to Diegner (2005), the philosophy of existentialism holds that the ultimate fate of human beings is death. It does not matter whether she has a good job or not. Aside from having a good job that covered her medical expenses, the only solution for Yosi Kanga was death. 1.5.2. Religious texts (the Christian religion, indigenous religions) indicate that Yosi Kanga had health problems since the past which were caused by childhood accidents. Whenever she faced a problem, she was taken to the hospital on a stretcher with a wheel that made a lot of noise. Every time the neighbor's children heard the noise of that stretcher’s wheel, they knew Yosi was being taken to the hospital. Those children stood near the wire fence of their fruit farm and made mocking and derisive gestures at him. The author says, “I wished I had the power of the Biblical David. I would climb onto that cart, look for a wild tunguja fruit or perhaps even a pebble, and strike them on their foreheads to silence their Goliath” (MWM). Page. 21). Yosi saw the neighborhood children as the Goliath of the Bible, who oppressed and mocked the children of Israel. According to the Christian religion, Goliath's oppression of the Israelites was ended by a young boy, David, who slung a stone and killed him. Yosi wished that if he had the strength of David, he would silence those children who laughed at him and belittled him. Moreover, he likens their laughter to Goliath. Earlier, the character Konzi owned a hotel where he worked together with his wife. The author explains that Konzi used to mistreat women, but this habit ended when he got married. However, he continued to offend his wife by desiring other women who came to the hotel, right before his wife’s eyes. Konzi’s wife, whose name is Tabitha, views this behavior as disobedience to the Creator. The one being referred to as the Creator is Almighty God. For Tabitha, such abuse is an act of disobedience to one of the Ten Commandments of God, which warns against adultery as recorded in the Bible (Exodus 20). Tabitha retaliated against her husband by abusing him even more. The author says that Tabitha burst into loud laughter, turning this way and that as if seeking the companionship of others. Finally, she asked her husband whether he really knew her well. Tabitha ended by saying, “If you’re a snake, then I’m the master at drawing out its poison!” (MWM. p.51). The text referred to in this narrative is superstitious. The author Wamitila explains that after this strange event, Mr. Konzi was unable to pass stool or urinate. He was unable to reach the hotel again, “to see those women with faces like tomatoes or to spread butter on their bread” (MWM. Okay. 51). It is evident that his wife used witchcraft to bewitch her husband in an attempt to control him because of "external influences." Moreover, when Konzi was taken to Machakos General Hospital, the doctors were unable to help him. The writer says that even X-ray images did not show any problem. When his abdomen was examined with a stethoscope, the sound heard resembled a rooster crowing. He was advised by the doctor to return home, where his wife laughed and scolded him. Later, she gave him a light slap on the cheek, and the problem of the lump disappeared. It has been revealed that Tabitha used supernatural powers to punish anyone who disrespected her, especially her husband, Konzi. When a community lacks appropriate mechanisms for ensuring justice, it seeks its own means. In this context, the method used by Tabitha disrupts order and morality within the community. Normally, a wife takes care of and respects her husband in every way. 1.5.3 Academic Texts The doctor told the character Yosi Kanga that the health problem he was experiencing was caused by a swelling on his head. He went on to mention that he did not have many days left to live. The author uses the following words to describe this situation: “It seems… hmm… he has a problem of brain tumour… or even intracranial hypertension…! If my diagnosis is correct, because I have never been wrong in all my years of medical practice, he has about twenty-eight days to live… in fact it might even be less!” Academic texts have been used to torment Yosi mentally and emotionally. The examination was not conducted properly because it is later revealed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor boasted of being a scholar who had studied medicine at renowned institutions, “an alumnus of prestigious universities” (MWM). Yes. 31). Thus, when he spoke about his patient’s condition, Joseph knew and believed the truth that his days on earth had come to an end. 1.5.4 Political Texts  
The political situation often oppresses members of society. It has been observed that in many developing countries, politicians use young people to advance their own interests. The author of the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi narrates a story concerning soldiers. He explains that their faces reminded him of the “gangs of men” used by the wealthy to threaten their debtors (MWM). Page. 106). Similarly, the author narrates about the character Moylee Gaga, who bought a house in the Golden Gate neighborhood at an auction after the homeowner failed to pay his mortgage while still living inside. The homeowner needed to move out of the house that had gotten a new owner. The person who bought it did not know how to evict the occupant, so Moylee Gaga was advised to find a gang of youths, as politicians do, give them money to buy alcohol on Madongokuinama Street, then have them go there at night and throw out the homeowner’s belongings, regardless of the crying and shouting from his family (MWM). Uk. 106 – 107). Here, even though the homeowner failed to pay the mortgage, their eviction was carried out in a manner that was unjust and abusive. Another political term that was used is the word “operation” (MWM). Op. 107). This word illustrates how society suffers at the hands of those who are expected to protect it. Moylee Gaga is further advised, "just make sure that the chief of police in that area is aware—I think you understand me—that you simply have a certain 'operation'; as long as he knows, then you have absolutely nothing to fear." Everything will go smoothly. Political language is evident in the words and actions of the various actors mentioned in this context. Njogu (1987) found in his study that the lower class (those living in Madongokuinama) constantly fight against the elite. Contrary to this study, the oppressed appear to accept their situation. Moreover, they accept being “used” by the elite in exchange for small items such as alcohol. Those in power abuse their authority to harm others who are in the lower class. Extreme oppression is when the writer says that it is enough for the police chief to simply know about a certain “operation.” This is contrary to the expectations of the community. This is consistent with Kamunde’s (1983) observation that members of the lower class are oppressed by those of the upper class, although they eventually become aware of this and fight for their rights. 1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing. Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights. Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society. The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism. Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism. However, there is a risk that reading and understanding the modern novel requires prior knowledge of many issues related to philosophy, various disciplines, religion, politics, popular language, and others. discourses.translated_txt: Authors of the modern Swahili novel convey messages to the audience by focusing on experimental literary techniques.

discourses.source_txt: Urejeleomatini ni mojawapo wa vipengele muhimu vya mbinu hizo za kimajaribio.
discourses.translated_txt: Intertextuality is one of the key elements of those experimental techniques.

discourses.source_txt: Watalaamu wengine wamezibaini kama “riwaya za Karne ya Ishirini na Moja.
discourses.translated_txt: Other experts have classified them as “Twenty-First Century novels.”

discourses.source_txt: Mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila ni mmojawapo wa waandishi wa kisasa anayetumia mtindo huu mpya wa kiuandishi katika kuzungumzia maswala mbalimbali yanayoikumba jamii.
discourses.translated_txt: The author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila is one of the modern writers who employs this new writing style to address various issues affecting society.

discourses.source_txt: Nadharia ya usasaleo imeongoza utafiti huu katika uchanganuzi wa kipengele cha urejeleomatini. Aina mbali mbali za matini zilizorejelewa katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma zilitambulishwa na kufafanuliwa.
discourses.translated_txt: The theory of postmodernism has guided this research in the analysis of the aspect of intertextuality. Various types of texts referenced in the presentation of the theme of violence were identified and explained.

discourses.source_txt: Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ilichaguliwa kimaksudi kwa kuwa inawasilishwa kwa simulizi nyingi fupi fupi zinazorejelea matini tofauti tofauti.
discourses.translated_txt: The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi was deliberately selected because it is presented through numerous short narratives that reference different texts.

discourses.source_txt: Mbinu ya uchanganuzi wa yaliyomo mkabala wa kimaelezo ilitumika kuchanganua deta iliyohusiana na swala zima la urejeleomatini. Deta ilichanganuliwa kwa kuangazia maudhui, mandhari na mbinu za kiuandishi za kimajaribio. Matokeo yaliwasilishwa kwa njia ya kimaelezo.
discourses.translated_txt: The descriptive content analysis method was used to analyze the data related to the overall issue of intertextuality. The data was analyzed by focusing on themes, settings, and key elements of experimental writing techniques. The findings were presented descriptively.

discourses.source_txt: Ilibainika kuwa ukosefu wa utaratibu katika uendeshaji wa mambo ndiyo taswira kamili ya jamii ya sasa.
discourses.translated_txt: It was revealed that a lack of order in the conduct of affairs is the true reflection of today's society.

discourses.source_txt: Matini zilizorejelewa zimeonyesha kuwa mwananchi amedhulumiwa na kupewa huduma duni na viongozi.
discourses.translated_txt: The referenced texts have shown that the ordinary citizen has been oppressed and provided with poor services by the leaders.

discourses.translated_txt: This article has examined and evaluated how the author uses the technique of intertextuality as a device for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.

discourses.translated_txt: Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory.

discourses.source_txt: Amekuwa na kazi nzuri na maisha mazuri.
discourses.translated_txt: He has had a good job and a good life.

discourses.source_txt: Siku moja hali ilimbadilikia punde tu aliposherehekea miaka thelathini na mitano tangu azaliwe.
discourses.translated_txt: One day, things changed for her soon after she celebrated her thirty-fifth birthday.

discourses.source_txt: Yosi Kanga alitoka ofisini saa saba kwa mapumziko ya mchana. Alijilaza katika bustani kisha usingizi ukambeba.
discourses.translated_txt: Yosi Kanga left the office at one o’clock for the afternoon break. She lay down in the garden, and soon sleep carried her away.

discourses.source_txt: Aliota ndoto akiwa hatarini. Katika ndoto hiyo, banati fulani aliyemfahamu kama msichana wa mbalamwezi alimwokoa.
discourses.translated_txt: He had a dream in which he was in danger. In that dream, a certain girl whom he knew as the msichana wa mbalamwezi saved him.

discourses.source_txt: Alielekea kujipa chakula cha mchana katika hoteli moja iliyokuwa karibu na makao makuu ya shirika la reli, Kenya Railways.
discourses.translated_txt: He went to get lunch at a hotel near the headquarters of the Kenya Railways Corporation.

discourses.source_txt: Baada ya chamcha anaanguka ghafla na kuugua.
discourses.translated_txt: After lunch, he suddenly collapses and falls ill.

discourses.source_txt: Alipelekwa katika City Breeze Hospital na kulazwa mle. Daktari alisema kwamba Yosi Kanga alikuwa na uvimbe kichwani na kwa sababu hiyo alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi.
discourses.translated_txt: He was taken to City Breeze Hospital and admitted there. The doctor said that Yosi Kanga had a tumor in his head and, because of that, he had a short time to live.

discourses.source_txt: Huduma mle hospitalini hazikuwa nzuri. Madaktari na baadhi ya wafanyikazi waliwadhulumu wagonjwa. Wengi wa wagonjwa hao walifariki kwa njia ambazo hazikueleweka.
discourses.translated_txt: The services in the hospital were not good. The doctors and some of the staff mistreated the patients. Many of those patients died in ways that were not understood.

discourses.source_txt: Baadaye daktari mwanamke alimtembelea.
discourses.translated_txt: Later, a female doctor visited her.

discourses.source_txt: Mara alipomwona, Yosi alipatwa na hisia fulani. Alijaribu kukumbuka alikokuwa amemwona yule daktari.
discourses.translated_txt: The moment he saw her, Yosi was overcome by a certain feeling. He tried to remember where he had seen that doctor before.

discourses.source_txt: Daktari alimjulia hali na baada ya mazungumzo mafupi aliamua kumpasulia mbarika.
discourses.translated_txt: The doctor checked on his condition and after a brief conversation decided to break the news to him.

discourses.source_txt: Uchunguzi na “scan zote za ECG reports” zilionyesha kuwa Yosi alikuwa buheri wa afya.
discourses.translated_txt: Examinations and all ECG scan reports showed that Yosi was in good health.

discourses.source_txt: Daktari alimwagiza ajitayarishe kuondoka mle hospitalini. Yosi alifurahi sana kwa kuwa ile “hukumu ya kifo” aliyopewa mle hospitalini ilifutiliwa mbali.
discourses.translated_txt: The doctor instructed him to prepare to leave the hospital. Yosi was very happy because the “death sentence” he had been given in the hospital was revoked.

discourses.source_txt: Kumbe huyu ndiye aliyekuwa mwokozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. 1.3 Usasaleo Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa katika misingi ya usasaleo. Elementi kuu ya usasaleo ni ukiukaji wa kaida za uandishi za kihalisia.
discourses.translated_txt:
So this was his savior, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions.

discourses.source_txt: Badala ya kuzingatia mfumo wa uhalisia mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila kama mwandishi wa kisasa ameandika riwaya hii kwa kuegemea uhalisia-mpya.
discourses.translated_txt: Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism.

discourses.source_txt: Rettova (2016) amemtaja Wamitila kama mwandishi anayeegemea usasaleo kwa kuwa anaenzi matumizi ya mbinu za kimajaribio.
discourses.translated_txt: Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques.

discourses.source_txt: Urejeleomatini ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa uandishi wa kisasaleo.
discourses.translated_txt: Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing.

discourses.source_txt: Wataalamu wamebaini kuwa ni vigumu kuweka mipaka kati ya usasa na usasaleo. Usasa ni kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambacho kilifungamana sana na mabadiliko katika sanaa hasa kati ya miaka ya 1880–1930 barani Uropa.
discourses.translated_txt: Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe.

discourses.source_txt: Wakati huo mwanadamu alidhihirisha uwezo na nguvu zake za kuumba, kuimarisha na kuunda mazingira yake kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, teknolojia na majaribio (Best et al, 2001).
discourses.translated_txt: At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001).

discourses.source_txt: Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba hapo awali fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanaa yalihusisha tanzu za fasihi kama vile ushairi, tamthilia, riwaya, densi na filamu.
discourses.translated_txt: These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film.

discourses.source_txt: Maudhui ya dhati, lugha ya dhati, uasilia, na utaratibu kabambe ndio mambo yaliyotiliwa maanani.
discourses.translated_txt: Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized.

discourses.source_txt: Miji ya Uropa iliyoshuhudia mabadiliko haya ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Rome, London na Moscow. Mabadiliko haya yaliitwa Usasa na haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa kiini na msingi wa usasaleo.
discourses.translated_txt: European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism.

discourses.source_txt: Abrams (1993) anashikilia kuwa Usasa hutumiwa kuelezea na kutambulisha sifa mpya za dhamira, tanzu, dhana na mitindo ya kifasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya Karne ya Ishirini yaani baada ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Ulimwengu. Abrams anaendelea kusisitiza kuwa sifa zinazorejelewa hutofautiana kutegemea wahakiki husika.
discourses.translated_txt: Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2007) anasema, “Licha ya tofauti hizo, wahakiki wengi wanakubaliana kuwa msingi wa sifa hizo ni kujitenga na misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Kimagharibi au ule uliokuwako”.
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.”

discourses.source_txt: Kwa mujibu wa haya, ni bayana kwamba usasa ulijitenga kabisa na taratibu za utunzi zilizofuatwa kabla ya Karne ya Ishirini. Hata ingawa suala la wakati wa kuzuka kwa usasa na usasaleo ni jambo la mjadala, ni wazi kwamba usasaleo uliibuka na kujengwa katika misingi ya usasa. Usasaleo uliibuka na kuasisiwa katika Karne ya Ishirini.
discourses.translated_txt: According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century.

discourses.source_txt: Ulihusishwa na Nietzchsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard miongoni mwa wengine.
discourses.translated_txt: It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others.

discourses.source_txt: Wataalamu wengine waliotoa michango yao kwa nadharia ya usasaleo ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987) ambaye anasisitiza kwamba ulimwengu wa sasa unajiegemeza zaidi kwenye maswala ya usasaleo ambapo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na binadamu wa sasa zinamulikwa kwa njia ya simulizi nyingi.
discourses.translated_txt: Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives.

discourses.source_txt: Mfafanuzi wa hivi majuzi wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala hii imejikita katika maoni mbalimbali ya nadharia usasaleo kama ilivyoasisiwa na Jean – Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991) na wengine.
discourses.translated_txt: A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others.

discourses.source_txt: Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia tete kwamba ufahamu wa wanajamii umebadilishwa pakubwa na mabadiliko ya kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imepelekea jamii kubadilisha tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kiusasaleo.
discourses.translated_txt: Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures.

discourses.source_txt: Kipindi cha usasaleo kilivuruga mipaka iliowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Hali hii imejitokeza katika mambo mbalimbali yanayomilikiwa na jamii ikiwemo fasihi.
discourses.translated_txt: The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature.

discourses.source_txt:
Maisha na watu si wataratibu na kwa hivyo kazi za fasihi hazifai kuwa na utaratibu wowote. Usasaleo unafungamana sana na utamaduni pendwa ambapo watu hufanya
mambo namna wanavyotaka wenyewe bila kufuata kanuni za kijadi.
discourses.translated_txt: Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms.

discourses.source_txt: Mwandishi anajipa kibali cha kutumia kazi ya msanii mwengine kuundia kazi mpya.
discourses.translated_txt: The writer gives himself permission to use another artist’s work to create a new one.

discourses.source_txt: Mintarafu ya haya, makala hii imetambulisha aina za matini zilizorejelewa na mwandishi K.W.Wamitila katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi kuwasilishia maudhui ya dhuluma. Isitoshe, imechanganua jinsi matini hizo zilivyotumika katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma. Utafiti huu ulijikita katika kipengele cha urejeleomatini.
discourses.translated_txt: With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Wamitila in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi to present the theme of oppression. Furthermore, it has analyzed how these texts were used in conveying the theme of oppression. This research focused on the aspect of intertextuality.

discourses.source_txt: Carter (2006) anafafanua kwamba usasaleo hukiuka kaida na kanuni zote za utunzi. Kanuni anazorejelea Carter zaweza kuwa za kimuundo na za kilugha.
discourses.translated_txt: Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic.

discourses.source_txt: Hivi ni kusema kwamba pamoja na fasihi pendwa, usasaleo huambatana na uigizaji pendwa.
discourses.translated_txt: This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance.

discourses.source_txt: Sifa moja maarufu katika fasihi pendwa ni “mkondo wa ung’amuzi” ambao ni mbinu ya kisimulizi katika uandishi wa kinathari inayotumia maelezo marefu yanayoyamulika mawazo yanayompitikia mhusika akilini (Wamitila, 2006).
discourses.translated_txt: One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006).

discourses.source_txt: Uigizaji huu hufanyika popote na haufuati utaratibu wowote. Aghalabu, lengo la mwandishi huwa ni kuburudisha jamii tu.
discourses.translated_txt: This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society.

discourses.source_txt: Uigizaji pendwa hutumia lugha pendwa.
discourses.translated_txt: Popular performance uses popular language.

discourses.source_txt: Kwa kuwa lugha ni kifaa muhimu katika uandishi wa kazi za fasihi usasaleo unaangazia matumizi ya lugha kwa njia huru sana bila kuzingatia ufasaha na usanifu wake. Pia huhusu kuchanganya lugha mbalimbali kwa mfano Kiingereza na Kiswahili au lugha za kwanza na Kiswahili. Dhana hii iliuelekeza utafiti huu katika uchanganuzi wa maswala mahususi ya matumizi ya lugha pendwa hasa uchanganyaji na uhamishaji ndimi katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Lugha iliyotumika hurejelea matini mbalimbali ambazo zinawasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma katika jamii. Msingi wa usasaleo ulitumika kuuongoza utafiti katika uchanganuzi wa urejeleomatini kama mojawapo wa kipengele muhimu cha riwaya za kimajaribio. Mtafiti amebaini jinsi kipengele hiki kilivyokosesha utaratibu katika riwaya teule.
discourses.translated_txt: Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel.

discourses.source_txt: 1.4 Urejeleomatini Urejeleomatini ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza “intertexuality” lililotumika kwa mara ya kwanza na mwanafalsafa mfaransa, Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake cha ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). Kwa mujibu wa Kristeva, kila neno ni urejeleo wa maneno mengine. Hivyo, kuna msisitizo kwamba matini huhusiana na kutegemeana ili kuleta maana.
discourses.translated_txt:
1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning.

discourses.source_txt: Stam (2000) katika Anderson (2004:1) ananukuliwa, “Matini yoyote ile iibukayo lazima iwe imelala pamoja na nyingine au na matini nyingine ambayo ile ya awali imelala nayo”.
discourses.translated_txt: Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.”

discourses.source_txt: Usemi huu unadhihirisha kuwa kazi ya fasihi haitoki kwenye akili ya mtunzi pekee au katika ombwe tupu bali huwa ni mkusanyiko wa matini nyingine tofauti tofauti.
discourses.translated_txt: This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts.

discourses.source_txt: (Anderson, 2004) anadai kuwa urejeleomatini huhusisha “yaliyosemwa tayari”. Urejeleomatini ni kipengele muhimu cha usasaleo ambamo Wamitila anaandikia.
discourses.translated_txt: (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes.

discourses.source_txt: Aidha, urejeleomatini ni mojawapo wa elementi kuu za uandishi wa kimajaribio. Urejeleomatini unaojitokeza aghalabu katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi umeshamiri matumizi ya vihadithi vidogo vidogo, tanzu za fasihi simulizi, maoni ya wanafalsafa, ushairi/nyimbo na uchanganyaji wa lugha.
discourses.translated_txt: In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing.

discourses.source_txt: Matini hizi zote zimetumika katika riwaya hii kuwasilisha maudhui ya dhuluma katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii kama vile afya, elimu na mapenzi. Hali hizi zote huingiliana na kutegemeana katika ukuzaji wa ubunifu wa mwandishi.
discourses.translated_txt: All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author.

discourses.source_txt: Kwa mujibu wa Julia Kristeva (1980) matini huwa na uhusiano na matini nyingine.
discourses.translated_txt: According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts.

discourses.source_txt: Makala hii imebaini kwamba katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui ya dhuluma katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi matini mbalimbali zinahusiana, kutangamana na kutegemeana.
discourses.translated_txt: This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other.

1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry.

discourses.translated_txt: This article has demonstrated how "ordinary" citizens are tormented by life in their country due to being deprived of essential services. This section has thoroughly explained the types of texts referenced by the author in his communication with society concerning oppression.

1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing.

discourses.translated_txt: Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*.

discourses.source_txt: Vilevile, imedhihirika kwamba jinsi maisha ya kisasa yanavyokosa utaratibu ndivyo fasihi ya kisasa ilivyo. Hata hivyo, ingawa hali ya ukosefu wa utaratibu katika utekelezaji wa shughuli mbalimbali waweza kuonekana kana kwamba haufai, unajitosheleza katika fasihi. Kutofaa huko ndiko maisha ya kisasa yaani taswira kamili ya jamii ya leo.
discourses.translated_txt: Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society.

discourses.source_txt: Riwaya ya Kiswahili ya sasa inaafaa kwani ndiyo kioo halisi cha jamii ya leo.imebainika kuwa simulizi ndogo ndogo zinazorejelea matini tofauti tofauti zinafaa katika uwasilishaji wa maudhui badala ya matumizi ya hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa katika msingi wa uhalisia.
discourses.translated_txt: The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism.

discourses.source_txt: Mtendakazi yeyote yule ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya za kutekeleza kazi yake bila kujibana na kujikita katika sheria za jadi. Hivyo basi, mtunzi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya za utunzi bila kubanwa na mbinu za kijadi ambazo zinajiegemeza katika msingi wa uhalisia.
discourses.translated_txt: Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism.

discourses.source_txt: Hata hivyo, kuna hatari kwamba usomaji na uelewa wa riwaya ya kisasa unahitaji ufahamu wa kiada wa maswala mengi yanayohusiana na falsafa, taaluma mbalimbali, dini, siasa, lugha pendwa na mengine.
